plain_english_revision: This amendment adds a new requirement for persons facilitating rental transactions of tangible personal property (specifically Class II or IV property) to report these rentals and notify lessors if they lack the required license. It also establishes penalties under Section 40-2A-11 for non-compliance.
candidate_position_supported: The amendment supports expanding regulatory oversight and enforcement mechanisms regarding the licensing of tangible personal property rentals to ensure compliance with existing tax statutes.
evidence_quotes: "c. To require reporting of rental transactions of tangible personal property..."

...by persons facilitating the transactions and to require notifications to the lessor when the lessor has not furnished evidence that it has acquired a license as required under Section 40-12-221, and to provide for penalties pursuant to Section 40-2A-11."
